label: WS_COLLAB
description: Coordination, audio, local STT, browser captions, emullm-backed ChatBot Test agents with spoken replies, and administration over durable JSONL event streams.
summary: Run the WS_COLLAB server, review its transports, and open its administration console.

mailboxEndpoint.description: Mailbox directory (unread counts, activity, virtual mailboxes); sibling routes /messages, /agents, /send, /cursor share this base.

servicesEndpoint.description: Generated endpoint inventory containing every supported route, method, purpose, authentication requirement, and visibility classification.

steps: Install the WS_COLLAB package into the repository .venv.
Start the standalone server, or set WS_COLLAB_PLUGIN_MODE=embedded to mount it in-process.
Open the administration console and confirm the transports answer.
Stop the standalone WS_COLLAB server (or unset WS_COLLAB_PLUGIN_MODE=embedded and stop the embedded mount).
This is a vendored nested project (its own .git) -- remove its directory entirely to uninstall it, or leave it and just disable scanning it (set scan: disabled in plugins.json).

plugin-init.description: Redirects /ws_collab to the Workspace Collab plugin.

plugin-lifecycle.note: Runs as its own standalone server by default (set WS_COLLAB_PLUGIN_MODE=embedded to mount it in-process instead). The local Python plugin.start_server() callable and python -m ws_collab.standalone start can start it after shutdown. The operator HTTP lifecycle API controls a running server; embedded mounts return 409 unless their host supplies lifecycle callbacks.

base.description: Canonical unversioned HTTP and WebSocket namespace, derived from routePrefix.

inventory.description: Generated inventory for every supported route, method, purpose, authentication requirement, and visibility classification.

status.description: Public, secret-free subsystem rollup with an overall verdict.

ready.description: Public readiness probe; returns 503 when the service cannot accept traffic.

websocket.description: Bidirectional event transport with subscriptions, publication, cursors, and liveness; message-specific roles are enforced.

captionSources.description: Lists the durable Chrome/Meet caption-source policy; explicit per-source enable, disable, and make-primary actions are operator-only.

captionerInstances.description: Lists recent browser captioner tab instances; operator-only per-instance enable, disable, and pinned selection actions control backend microphone authority.

languageChat.description: ChatBot Test agent configuration, prompt/history, emullm model replies, automatic STT monitoring, and single-client browser TTS.

config.description: Operations workbench served through the workbench proxy (same page as configPage).

restart.description: Requires operator capability (admin qualifies). After a 202 acknowledgement is flushed, standalone mode safely stops and rebinds under its supervisor; embedded mode returns 409 unless the host supplies a restart callback. Authenticated-session requests also enforce CSRF and origin checks.

shutdown.description: Requires operator capability (admin qualifies). After a 202 acknowledgement is flushed, standalone mode gracefully stops its servers; embedded mode returns 409 unless the host supplies a shutdown callback. Authenticated-session requests also enforce CSRF and origin checks.

plugin-api.note: Only discovery and control surfaces useful to the plugin host are listed here; GET /ws_collab/endpoints is authoritative. Paths are canonical values composed from routePrefix, and no /v1 compatibility paths are supported. An embedding host that overrides routePrefix must compose runtime URLs from its configured value and consult its endpoint inventory.
